{{Quote|T7 &#61; 12 other partners // T7 + doctor // T7 + mechanic // T7 + Senator's aide // T7 + others|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="Zallow" />}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Zallow" /> sometime before the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that [[T7-O1]] was active for at least 200 years, and information gathered from other conversations with T7-O1 makes it clear that the droid was partnered with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] for the entire [[Great Galactic War]].</ref> During the senator's career, [[Unidentified Senatorial aide|one of the senator's aides]] was the partner of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] for some amount of [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Zallow" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Zallow" />
